name: Lyo.Avalonia.Components
tagline: Shared Avalonia controls for Lyo desktop apps.
description: Desktop apps share this library the way Blazor hosts share `Lyo.Web.Components`. `ToolDockBuilder` lays named panes around a center control on the left, right, or bottom. `ToolDockHit` picks the drop edge while a title bar is dragged. `ScreenEdgeDock` parks a window on the nearest screen edge. `EdgeDockBar` is the tab on that edge: the app sets its size, icon, and buttons. `EdgeDockWindow` hides the window contents, places the bubble, and puts the window back when the drag leaves the edge. Click, double-click, and the buttons stay with the app. `AvaloniaDesktop.Configure` starts a desktop app with platform detection and the Inter font. `Tabber` is the shared tab strip: each page is parented once, and selecting a tab only shows that page.
features: **Tool windows.** `ToolDockState` records each pane's edge, visibility, and whether it is minimized. `ToolDockBuilder.Fill` stacks left and right panes vertically and bottom panes sideways, with splitters and a header the user can drag. Minimize collapses that pane to its header and shrinks the edge when every pane there is minimized. Close hides the pane; the host rebuilds from the changed callback.

**Screen edge.** `ScreenEdgeDock.Place` chooses the nearest edge from the window center and clamps the tab inside the work area. `Expand` grows the window inward. `Clamp` pulls an open tab back onto the screen without leaving its edge. `IconBias` shifts the icon toward a corner so turning onto the next edge does not throw it outward. `PulledOff` says when a drag has left the edge.

**Edge tab.** `EdgeDockBar` draws the icon and any number of buttons. `Thickness`, `Length`, and `Corner` set the shape. Hover opens the buttons, and leaving closes them. Click, double-click, and drag are events the app handles. `EdgeDockWindow` owns the docked flag, the rest position, and the settle loop that puts the title bar back. `EdgeDockRest` is the open size: a fixed height, or height from the content.
**Prompts.** `PromptDialog.AskAsync`, `ConfirmAsync`, and `ShowTextAsync` are owned dialogs with the shared dark chrome. `Labeled`, `Stack`, and `Buttons` are the pieces a domain dialog reuses.

**Key and value.** `KeyValueView` draws a key with a value that is selectable text, an image, or any control such as a chip. Text can be selected, and Copy writes that value. `NameValueList` is the text-only form used for play context, a captured request, and an element inspection.
**JSON.** `JsonEditor` shows a JSON document as a virtualized tree or as raw text. The tree searches, expands, collapses, colors values, and copies one node. A body that is not JSON stays as text.
**Tabs.** `Tabber` keeps each page parented once and only changes which page is visible. Headers can close, rename, and disable.

**Log.** `LogView` is a virtualized log fed by `LogSink`. Each row has an eye, a timestamp, a level chip, and the message. The toolbar filters by level and text, follows the tail, and copies or exports the visible lines. The eye opens `LogLineView`: the message, scope and structured context, and for an exception the crash site, frames, and raw text from `StackTraceDecoder`.
